geometry_notes: Plain split cam housings and unsplit rocker-shaft bores; no selected bearing alloy or fit.
M6-like base and M5-like cap bolt envelopes, blind pilot bores; no manufactured threads or torque specification.
Four external oil-feed drillings with branches to the journals; pump, restrictors and oil-film performance unknown.
Two oblique returns join the existing head gallery; no sealed rocker cover, gasket, hose or oil cooler selected.
Head mounting bores and returns are new design features; engine interfaces remain unverified.

load_sensitivity.note: Independent hypothetical cases, not a measured duty cycle, hot spring law or combustion solution.

thermal_sensitivity.note: 250 C is a screening ceiling, not an allowable. h, oil data and constant k are assumed. No published k(T) is assigned.

motion_scope: end supports separated in y from lobes/rockers/valves at every phase; journal cylinder rotation invariant

limitations: uniform fin base temperature, no head conduction resistance
constant cold inlet air, no duct/fan pressure loss
no local exhaust bridge or combustion heat-flux map
fully flooded gallery assumption is not the G6 gravity-return condition
no temperature-dependent material law or radiation model; no operating-temperature prediction
effective mass assumed, not inferred from component CAD
steel E=200 GPa assumed in shaft bound
two simply-supported journals, no carrier compliance or oil film
no material strength allowables, Hertz, fatigue or cam-drive torque qualification
no engine-compatible chain drive or thrust/axial retention
carrier stiffness, cap preload, bearing films and thread pullout not qualified
no sealed cover or oil-return hoses
no full-head CHT/FEA or melt-pool/residual-stress simulation
